reason: Money's not the issue, so if I see it in a café I'll grab one to see what yerba mate tastes like after a ride. But I've had the same energy drink for years and I know exactly how it hits, so this is a one-off, not a switch.
objection: 80 mg feels mild next to what I'm used to and I don't know how mate hits me. My drink works, so why change it.
would_change_my_mind: If it actually kept me sharp without the crash on long weekend rides, I could see it replacing a few of my usual cans.
